name: Day Probe
about: Day Probe (1978-078F, ARC), launched 1978 Aug  8. Its phases from GCAT: HCO, Venus. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; carried by another craft, whose orbit this is
